feature_contract.goal: Preserve original GOAL 0-99 progress and final result title/time glyph binocular source identity across native shader c64 writes, rejecting foreign original shader/epoch before either stereo eye while maintaining native fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the original GOAL/result finite ScreenHud shader route; do not relabel StageExtensionTime +TIME, original gameplay 6th/6, lens, world, SkyGlow, rank, R26_SAFE, input/FFB, DX11 or frozen DXVK; Quest3 remains untested.
trace_stages: Original OutRun GOAL 0-99 progress, nineteen B9200 result glyphs and time helpers produce exact source-owned HUD callbacks.
R84 R33 native shader GOAL physical draw retrieves the ORIGINAL raw game c64 upload shader identity/epoch and nonzero write/draw serial before its left-eye c64 upload.

GOAL shader capture rejects a known foreign/partial generation before the first eye and verifies the identical source again after native left before submitting right; unmatched queues fall back to original Draw and state restoration, host XR acceptance untested.
subcomponents: Implement an exact original-game c64 shader/epoch admission predicate for the complete finite GOAL/result HUD producer family, including original shader-unbound and unavailable-tracker paths.
Wire pre-left and post-left source capture to the R84 R33 GOAL shader owner while preserving native original matrix rollback and right-eye safety fence.
Add compile-time positive and negative GOAL regression assertions for same, foreign, stale, partial, original-unbound and absent captured source.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The original GOAL or result glyph physical draw with captured c64 metadata is accepted only for an identical native vertex shader and generation before left and unchanged again before right.

Foreign shader, stale epoch and incomplete original c64 metadata reject stereo ownership; missing tracker and original unbound shader keep previous safe native behavior; +TIME, SkyGlow, input, FFB and R26_SAFE are unaffected.
Exact final validation-bearing commit passes DX9Ex Active Windows game/host/package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact without skipping CI; HMD correctness is not claimed.

diagnosis.original_evidence: GOAL 0-99 and nineteen B9200 original result glyph callers reach native shader ScreenHud R84 physical GPU submission, separate from StageExtensionTime +TIME.
diagnosis.root_cause: R33 captureGoalSource discarded missing/partial raw tracker but never matched a captured raw game c64 writer's shader identity or epoch to the actual GOAL shader. A known foreign write therefore looked complete and eligible for two eyes.
source_trace: Original GOAL and B9200 result producers establish exact ScreenHud/ProducerToken and SpriteNode or bounded direct D3DX source ownership.
R84 R33 captureGoalSource now validates original c64 shader/epoch before native LEFT submission without confusing R32's private eye upload with original writes.
The existing after-LEFT recapture and native original c64 rollback/right-eye fence preserve original fallback; exact HMD geometry and image presentation remain unobserved.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Both eyes require the same physical GOAL source, shader identity and generation, stable pose and queue identity; foreign original c64 cannot become a GOAL binocular matrix.
alternatives_rejected: Do not reuse +TIME StageExtensionTime token for GOAL or broaden ScreenHud to world and unknown glyphs.
Do not zero out a captured foreign original WVP and relabel it as unavailable so that the old fallback accidentally admits stereo ownership.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R84 GOAL source-header predicate and R33 physical GPU pre-left capture changed in material source; HMD symptoms require actual headset reproduction.
